title: The bedroom chair comes alive
body: Very early one morning the landlord of the Iping inn and his wife noticed that their guest's door, which was usually shut and locked, stood wide open. The scientist was always furious if anyone entered his room, so the chance seemed too good to miss. They peeped in and saw nobody. The bedclothes were cold, and the clothes and bandages that the guest always wore lay about the room. Suddenly Mrs Hall heard a sniff close to her ear. The hat on the bedpost leapt up and struck her face, and then the bedroom chair sprang into the air and charged at her, legs foremost. The chair pushed the couple out of the room, and the door seemed to slam and lock itself behind them. Mrs Hall, almost in hysterics, was sure that the room was haunted by spirits which the stranger had somehow sent into her furniture. The neighbours, too, felt that it was witchcraft.
